items: Any non-silver ring you are willing to lose
Any normal/oak/willow/maple/yew shortbow or longbow (if courting Astrid)
One of these, to raise approval: an axe (45 Woodcutting), a rake (10 Farming), a pickaxe (35 Mining), or a harpoon or lobster pot (35 Fishing)
rec: Dramen staff if travelling via Fairy Ring CIP
rewards: Ability to teleport to Miscellania with the Ring of Wealth.

st.t: Travel to Miscellania. You can take a boat from Rellekka. You can also use Fairy Rings to teleport there with the code CIP If you've unlocked them.
Buy some flowers from the Flower Girl in the courtyard of Miscellania castle for 15gp.
Go upstairs in Miscellania castle and talk to King Vargas. You can choose whether to get Brand's or Astrid's approval.
s: If I may be so bold...

i: Any normal/oak/willow/maple/yew shortbow or longbow (if courting Astrid)
Any non-silver ring you are willing to lose

sec.n: Win over Astrid (only if you chose her)

st.t: Only do this section if you chose Princess Astrid. If you chose Prince Brand, skip to the section "Win over Brand (only if you chose him)". Go upstairs in the Miscellania castle.
Keep talking to Princess Astrid, in the room directly north of the King, until she only says "Good day".
Use flowers on Astrid.
Dance in Princess Astrid's room.
Keep talking to Princess Astrid until she only says "Good day".
s: That sounds like a good idea.
I'm quite fond of it myself.

st.t: Use any bow on Astrid.
i: Any normal/oak/willow/maple/yew shortbow or longbow (if courting Astrid)

st.t: Keep talking to Princess Astrid until she calls you "Dear" or "Darling".
s: I suppose you don't have much opportunity to.
And what a great bard he makes!

st.t: Blow kiss emote next to Princess Astrid.
Use a ring on Astrid.
i: Any non-silver ring you are willing to lose

sec.n: Win over Brand (only if you chose him)

st.t: Only do this section if you chose Prince Brand. If you won over Princess Astrid, skip to the section "Establish peace". Go upstairs in the Miscellania castle.
Keep talking to Prince Brand, in the room directly south of the King, until he only says "Good day".
s: You will be the greatest bard!
They don't understand your poetry as I do.

st.t: Use flowers on Prince Brand.
Use the Clap emote next to Prince Brand
Keep talking to Prince Brand until he only says "Good day".
s: A much nobler pursuit, to be sure.

st.t: Give Prince Brand a cake.
Keep talking to Prince Brand until he greets you with "Hello, dear" or "Hello, darling".
s: I wouldn't presume to have the skill...

st.t: Use the blow kiss emote next to Prince Brand
Use a ring on Prince Brand.
i: Any non-silver ring you are willing to lose

st.t: Leave the castle and head east, across the bridge, to Etceteria castle. Go upstairs and talk to Queen Sigrid.
Talk to King Vargas.
Talk to Queen Sigrid.
Talk to Prince Brand in Miscellania castle.
Talk to Advisor Ghrim.
s: How do I make peace with Etceteria?

st.t: Return to Queen Sigrid in Etceteria castle.
Return to King Vargas.
Talk to Derrik in the north of Miscellania.
s: I have a slightly strange request...

st.t: Use the giant nib on some logs. Cut a nearby evergreen if you don't have logs.
Talk to King Vargas with the giant pen.

Reach 75% support. Talk to Advisor Ghrim, next to King Vargas upstairs in the castle, to check your rating. You can do any of the following: Rake the farming patches (10 Farming). Mining coal (30 Mining). Cutting maple trees (45 Woodcutting). Fish tuna with a harpoon or lobsters with a lobster pot.
Talk to King Vargas to finish the quest.
